definition: disgust maybe being only the reflex loud enough for me to catch, not the only one

settled:
Disgust being the only survivor may only mean it is the only one that comes out where I can see it.

My inner signals run below the level I notice anything at, so a reflex can fire and read to me as nothing at all.

The test case is my mouth watering. Thinking of a meal I loved, I can tell there is an association with my mouth watering, and I cannot tell whether my mouth is actually watering.

The disgust one shows on my face, so it is the one I can confirm.

So whatever else might survive has to be tested on signals visible from outside rather than by looking inward.

title: Whether Anything Else Survives The Gate
